confident_case.query: what error is returned when the embedded store directory does not exist

derivation: Measured 2026-09-23 on a full-repo graph (15,098 File/Symbol candidates - the exact candidate_from_record population - embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via sentence-transformers, exact candidate_text format). 27 answerable queries from corpus/semantic_relevance_corpus.json, 20 unanswerable (5 ambiguous + 15 held-out from corpus/semantic_confidence_unanswerable.json). With confident>=0.39: 24/27 answerable (88.9%) classify confident, meeting the >=85% bar. With weak>=0.34: 19/20 unanswerable (95.0%) classify weak/abstain, meeting the >=90% bar. The candidate 0.55/0.50 thresholds were rejected: only 3/27 answerable (11%) scored >=0.55. This supersedes the flawed 2026-09-22 measurement, which embedded every node with non-empty text (4,501 nodes including Diagnostics/PanicRiskSites) and omitted src/cli/mod.rs, claiming 23/27 (85.2%) and 18/20 (90%). Scores are max cosine similarities per query; the fixture cases are q016 (confident, 0.6191), q025 (weak, 0.3525), u01 (abstain, 0.1445).
